brief.title: Pre-Mission Brief
briefParagraphs: Four operations. Four objections answered. The crew is in the room for the first time — all of them. I'm stepping back. The plan has to stand without me holding it up.
ECHO works with you first: choose how to frame each evidence card and which visualisation format makes it legible to a non-technical room.
Then you present. Each specialist challenges you once — a question from their domain. Get all four to commit and the operation ships.
You built this dossier across four operations. Now you have to sell it to the people who have to act on it.
brief.pullquote: The room doesn't care what you found. It cares what it means.

dossier.name: ZEX · ATLAS · NOVA · KADE

brief.ackGateLabel: I understand — all four crew members must commit for the operation to ship

steps.title: FRAME WITH ECHO
steps.description: Four evidence cards from Ops 1–4. For each card: pick a framing type (risk / opportunity / neutral) and a visualisation format. ECHO gives you one line of feedback per choice — read it before moving on.

steps.title: CREW BRIEFING
steps.description: Present the framed dossier. Each specialist — ZEX, ATLAS, NOVA, KADE — challenges you once with a multiple-choice question from their domain. One retry is available per crew member, at a detection cost.

steps.title: THE VOTE
steps.description: All four specialists must commit. VOSS closes the session either way. No retries on the vote — the debrief shows exactly which answers caused each crew member to stay sceptical.

detection.title: THE DETECTION METER
paragraphs: Every mistake raises the meter. Hit 100% and MegaCorp closes the connection — the briefing room goes dark and the operation is over.
detection.hint: Stuck? ECHO's feedback lines on each card are your hints. Read them before confirming — they tell you exactly what each crew member needs to hear and whether your choice lands.
